INSPECTION PROCEDURE 1: Selector Lever can be Moved from "P" to "R" without Depressing Brake 
Pedal when Ignition Key is at Positions other than "LOCK" (OFF).
TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION (COMMENT)
• Lock cam or shift lock cable may be defective.
TROUBLESHOOTING HINTS
• Malfunction of lock cam
• Malfunction of shift lock cable
DIAGNOSIS
Check items described in the column 
"Troubleshooting Hints." When the brake pedal is 
released with the ignition key at other positions than 
"LOCK" (OFF), check that the selector lever can not 
be moved from "P" position to "R" position.
